title: stainless steel coffee mug
text: stainless steel coffee mug. So.  I like HOT HOT coffee... so I had hopes that these cups would keep the coffee hotter, longer... Not so much... But here are my personal opinion/thoughts...  the "metal" aspect was not appealing with a hot drink.  But then I don't like soda pop unless it's in a glass bottle... They are better for "cold" drinks.. like a moscow mule or other...  I have washed them in the dishwasher several times... so far so good.  The bottom line for me is they are "okay" for cold drinks... not really for hot drinks to me.  The metallic taste is counter for me.  However, on the "up" side to me, the handles are wide - comfortable to hold, the mugs are very light - which also reminds me - they are NOT insulated - they are doubled-walled so you will feel some heat if you use with hot liquids.

product_metadata.title: Stainless Steel Coffee Mug, Set of 2-13.5 oz Premium Double Wall Insulated Travel Mugs - Shatterproof, Dishwasher Safe, Comfortable Handle Cups for Tea, Beer
